problem_text:
A logistics manager needs to distribute a total shipment volume across 19 different distribution routes to maximize the overall delivery efficiency of the network.
The characteristics of each route are as follows:
* Route A: efficiency score is 0.118, congestion factor is 0.111, allocation bounds [0.087, 0.511]
* Route B: efficiency score is 0.049, congestion factor is 0.170, allocation bounds [0.042, 0.318]
* Route C: efficiency score is 0.154, congestion factor is 0.095, allocation bounds [0.073, 0.408]
* Route D: efficiency score is 0.187, congestion factor is 0.226, allocation bounds [0.080, 0.494]
* Route E: efficiency score is 0.055, congestion factor is 0.154, allocation bounds [0.061, 0.775]
* Route F: efficiency score is 0.025, congestion factor is 0.159, allocation bounds [0.060, 0.515]
* Route G: efficiency score is 0.024, congestion factor is 0.126, allocation bounds [0.042, 0.344]
* Route H: efficiency score is 0.112, congestion factor is 0.066, allocation bounds [0.056, 0.694]
* Route I: efficiency score is 0.047, congestion factor is 0.060, allocation bounds [0.037, 0.523]
* Route J: efficiency score is 0.176, congestion factor is 0.209, allocation bounds [0.062, 0.768]
* Route K: efficiency score is 0.041, congestion factor is 0.267, allocation bounds [0.006, 0.373]
* Route L: efficiency score is 0.059, congestion factor is 0.092, allocation bounds [0.016, 0.491]
* Route M: efficiency score is 0.079, congestion factor is 0.124, allocation bounds [0.003, 0.307]
* Route N: efficiency score is 0.060, congestion factor is 0.179, allocation bounds [0.050, 0.497]
* Route O: efficiency score is 0.151, congestion factor is 0.232, allocation bounds [0.058, 0.579]
* Route P: efficiency score is 0.189, congestion factor is 0.100, allocation bounds [0.029, 0.777]
* Route Q: efficiency score is 0.068, congestion factor is 0.240, allocation bounds [0.081, 0.839]
* Route R: efficiency score is 0.107, congestion factor is 0.287, allocation bounds [0.063, 0.637]
* Route S: efficiency score is 0.192, congestion factor is 0.151, allocation bounds [0.095, 0.531]

Each route must receive a proportion of the total shipment volume that satisfies its individual minimum and maximum allocation bounds, and the sum of all shipment proportions must equal one. To maintain network reliability, the manager requires that the group of high-priority routes, represented by the subset H = {D, G, I, J, L, M, Q}, collectively handle at least 0.322 of the total shipment volume.

Additionally, the overall network congestion index must not exceed 0.239, and the total delivery efficiency score must be no less than 0.070. Please determine the optimal shipment allocation across routes that maximizes the total delivery efficiency while satisfying all constraints.
